howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: Without a valid Brevo Conversations ID no widget appears, even with Brevo Chat Widget aktiv switched on — and there is no error message about it.
howTo.item2: Cookie Consent Management decides whether the widget loads only after consent or right away.
howTo.item3: With consent required, the storefront's cookie settings gain an extra Chat und Kommunikation category.
howTo.item4: The widget reacts to a changed consent immediately, without a page reload.
howTo.item5: The settings apply per sales channel — the selector sits at the top of this page.

info.description: GDPR-compliant integration of the Brevo chat widget into the storefront, loading the chat only after consent via the Shopware cookie consent and configurable per sales channel.
